mapper.update: INSERT INTO finance (merge_key, accounting_standards, fiscal_year_cover_page) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{accountingStandards}, #{fiscalYearCoverPage}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO company_finance (company_id, finance_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{financeId}, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid) ON CONFLICT (company_id, finance_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE company_finance SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE deleted = false AND company_id = #{companyId}
UPDATE company_finance SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE deleted = false AND company_id = #{companyId} AND sync_id != #{syncId}::uuid
